angleConvention: clockwise from 12 o'clock; 0 is up; screen y positive down
classRules: A Hough segment close in angle to a known reference is only a candidate, not an accepted gauge graduation.
Circumference/rim, text strokes and needles may produce false positives.
Source identity, scale mode, minor-tick interpretation and exact pivot are required before live needle binding.
Linear tracks have no rotary pivot and are not angle-interpolated.
